messages:
noah: quick sync — we need one small re-scope for the April milestone. two options: surgical cut to reduce testing surface or push freeze by 6 days. which do folks prefer?
rei: can you enumerate the risky pieces?
noah: risky: 1) cross-tenant permission sync UI polish, 2) realtime embedding warm path (dash), 3) admin scheduled exports (customer ask). small: debug trace toggle.
gina: my vote: keep exports (customers will actually use it) and drop the UI polish. make the export async to reduce QA matrix.
harry: agree. async exports + trace toggle in MVP. pinning UI to v1. That saves ~2 dev-weeks of integration testing.
rei: if we go async export we must add audit entries + retention policy. security sign-off needed.
gina: security OK with scoped export (S3 link, 48h expiry, RBAC check). I'll file the sec review now.
ops-bot: security review ticket SEC-612 created. Add reviewers: linda, pete.
noah: timeline impact: with exports + trace toggle we still need an extra 6 days of freeze to get full regression pass given infra constraints week-of-4/6. Alternatively we can cut export to v1 and keep freeze as-is.
harry: prefer small freeze (+6d). customer demo stability >>> marginal earlier ship.
rei: can we compromise: enable export in MVP but behind tenant whitelist / feature flag and only for pilot tenants? then we reduce blast radius.
gina: good call. whitelist + flag + audit = MVP export. I'll scope the flag in the spec.
noah: ok decision: MVP = async admin export (beta-feature-flagged for pilot tenants) + trace toggle + debug hook. v1 = pinning UI + warm dashboard + polished perms sync. Freeze window +6 days.
deploy-bot: milestone updated "2026-04-mini-launch" freeze +6 days, canary rollout 3% -> 25% -> 100%. rollback target: last-stable.
ops-bot: action items: @gina draft export acceptance (1d), @rei request security ack (SEC-612), @harry update release playbook (2d), @noah communicate to pilot customers. Reconvene tomorrow 10am PT.
noah: thanks all. ping if anything changes. :thumbsup:
